patthana17.5:1.1: kusalaṃ savitakka savicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na savitakka savicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā terasa. kusalo pañca, akusale pañca. abyākate tīṇi.
patthana17.5:2.1: kusalaṃ avitakka vicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na avitakka vicāramatto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā terasa.
patthana17.5:3.1: kusalaṃ avitakka avicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na avitakka avicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
